verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research workspace, so data export and portability is a fair axis. The evidence documents no export capability. Markdown notes in the workspace, an organization data-removal request, and MCP/API query access are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a documented way to export all of your data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
